about.subtitle: Founder of Wings of Love | Holistic Therapist
about.bio1: Holistic therapy is a health and wellness care approach that sees the person as a whole, not just as a symptom or a disease. It considers in an integrated way the physical, mental, emotional, spiritual, and social aspects.
about.bio2: The central idea is that everything is connected: if something is not in balance in one of these areas, it can affect the others.
goals: Restore the integral balance of the person
Address the root cause of problems, not just the symptoms

reiki.desc: Reiki is a universal energy channeling technique that activates the body's natural healing process. Through laying on of hands, energy centers are balanced promoting deep relaxation, reducing stress and restoring physical, emotional and spiritual well-being.

barras.desc: Access Bars is a technique that involves gently touching 32 points on the head to release energetic blockages, limiting thoughts, beliefs and emotions that no longer serve you.

angelical.desc: As a Medium and Angelic Coach, Liliana channels messages from your angels and spiritual guides to provide you with guidance, clarity and healing when you need it most.
